BulkOperationOperation.description:
Query-Transform-Set (QTS) GraphQL operation definition. The service queries
resources, optionally transforms field values, substitutes template variables
into mutationVariables, then executes the mutation per target item.

mutation.description: GraphQL mutation executed once per resolved target item

mutationVariables.description:
Mutation variables template. String values may reference extracted or
transformed fields with `${fieldName}` placeholders (for example
`${priceId}`, `${newPrice}`). Placeholders are substituted per item
before the mutation is executed.

query.description:
GraphQL query used to discover target resources and extract field values.
The query should support cursor pagination via first/after (or equivalent)
when operating over large result sets.

queryFields.description:
Fields extracted from each query result row. Each fieldName must be unique.
path is an RFC 9535 JSONPath into the query response; the optional root
prefix `$`. may be omitted (for example `edges[*].node.id`).

fieldName.description: Name of the extracted field available for transforms and templates

path.description:
RFC 9535 JSONPath into the query response. Use `[*]` to select every
array element. Examples: `edges[*].node.id`, `edges[*].node.value.value`.

queryVariables.description:
Optional variables passed to the GraphQL query. Typically includes filters
and pagination arguments such as first and after.

transforms.description:
Optional ordered transforms that compute new field values from queryFields
(or previous transform outputs). Each output name must be unique and must
not collide with a queryFields fieldName. Each input must reference a
queryField name or a previous transform output.

operations.description:
Ordered operations applied to the input value. Supported operation
types are percentageChange, percentageGrossChange, add, round, and
roundToIncrement.

increment.description:
Positive increment in minor currency units for
roundToIncrement (for example 5 nickel, 25 quarter, 50
half-dollar, 100 dollar).

value.description:
Decimal string operand for percentageChange,
percentageGrossChange, or add. Wire format is a string
(for example `"15"`, `"-4.5"`, or `".5"`); numeric JSON
literals are rejected. For percentage operations, this is
the percentage rate (positive or negative). For add, this
is the fixed amount added to the input (negative
subtracts). Same pattern as common-types percentage.

endpoints.description:
List bulk operations for a store. Supports optional OData-style
`filter`, `pageSize`, and `pageToken`.

Filter guidance:
- Equality/inequality (`eq` / `ne`) is commonly used with `status`
  (for example `status eq 'PROCESSING'` or
  `status ne 'CANCELED,COMPLETED,FAILED'`). Multiple status values
  may be comma-separated.
- Range filters (`ge` / `le`) are supported only on `createdAt` and
  require ISO 8601 timestamps (for example
  `createdAt ge '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'`).
- Results are returned newest-first.

Create a new bulk operation. Existing REST create requests remain
supported. GraphQL clients may submit a Query-Transform-Set
`operation` payload or a legacy `mutation`/`mutationVariables`
payload.

Query-Transform-Set requests (`operation` present) acquire a scoped
lock per store href and mutation target. Concurrent QTS operations
for the same store and mutation target may be rejected with
409 Conflict.

GraphQL create payloads (mutation/mutationVariables/operation) must
stay under the 256KB EventBridge limit or the request is rejected
with 400 Bad Request.

409.description: Conflict with the current resource state

endpoints.description: Get a bulk operation by ID

Cancel an ongoing bulk operation. This is a state transition; the
operation remains retrievable via GET with status CANCELED.
A dedicated POST .../cancellations controller resource is a follow-up
alignment with bulk-ingestions/bulk-exports.

Get errors during a bulk operation. For Query-Transform-Set
operations, error details may include mutationVariablesResolved so
clients can identify failed targets and retry them.
